$comment: Blanc coverage manifest, read by tools/blanc-drift.cjs.
Every member of DesktopWinSection (src/shared/desktop.ts) must appear here.
'covered' must name a real BLANC_TOOL_IDS entry (blancToolId) or a Blanc tab
surface (blancSurface). A tab-routed bail-out to a Study OS tab is NOT
coverage, and neither is a render branch that mounts a Study OS *View —
both are Pillar 0 violations and stay 'pending' until rebuilt Blanc-native.

library.note: Blanc's Read tab is a native panel, not an embed.

note.note: Blanc's quick-notes is deliberately local and separate from Notebook.

musicwidget.note: Taskbar widget; the full music library is tracked under 'music'.

settings.reason: Blanc has its own settings panel with its own schema (toolboxSettings). Mirroring Study OS settings would be two editors over different stores.

city.reason: City is its own desktop with its own engine and simulation loop. Pulling it into Blanc would defeat Pillar 1 outright.

flashcards.note: Rebuilt Blanc-native 2026-07-21; composes FlashcardsContent (review/mining/csv/ai/overview). AI Studio hidden in Blanc.

novels.note: Ported Blanc-native 2026-07-21 (Stream B); composes NovelsContent (useNovels + filters/table/inspector). NovelsView is 1004 → 119 lines. Verified live: 208 titles, three-pane jiten-workbench, 0 .ui-app-chrome.

games.note: Ported Blanc-native 2026-07-21 (Stream B); composes GameArenaContent's GameArena, shared verbatim with Study OS. GameArenaView is 1053 → 8 lines. Verified live: arena renders 13 game entries with XP/streak/badges, 0 .ui-app-chrome.

visualizer.note: Ported Blanc-native 2026-07-21 (Stream B); composes VisualizerContent (useVisualizer + VizStage) over the shared audioBus — no second audio graph. Verified live: canvas stage plus Style/React-to/Colors controls, 0 .ui-app-chrome.

music.note: Ported Blanc-native 2026-07-20; composes MusicContent. Shares playerBus with the FocusMusicBar widget.

scraper.note: Covered 2026-09-06 by BlancDiscoverPanel (BlancLibraryPanels.tsx), which composes useDiscovery + DiscoveryControls/Tabs/Results/Inspector from components/discover/DiscoverContent.tsx. This entry was 'pending' while the port it prescribes was already built and lazily registered — the drift tool cannot detect that, so it read as an open gap. Verified live on /blanc-harness.html, not from the file existing: the panel renders 'Search the catalogue' with the feed and JLPT-level controls, .ui-app-chrome is 0 and there is exactly one .blanc-tool-detail, so Pillar 0 holds. WHAT IS DELIBERATELY NOT COVERED, so 'covered' is not misread as parity: the acquisition shell (ScraperApp's own AppChrome, rail, status bar and 17 pages) is a Pillar 2 non-goal and Blanc will not mirror it. The study-relevant slice is the discovery console, and that is what this is.

immersion.note: Ported Blanc-native 2026-07-21 (Stream B); composes ImmersionContent (useImmersion + toolbar/stage/rail/popups). ImmersionView is 1027 → 330 lines. The read-only 'immersion-tracker' tool stays alongside it. Verified live: toolbar, sites rail, reader mode, and Live mode mounting a real <webview> guest in the Blanc window — 0 .ui-app-chrome.

agent.note: Ported Blanc-native 2026-09-06 as the 'agent' tool (BlancCentralAgentPanel.tsx). This section is coverage ONLY because Blanc gained the provider/EXECUTION seam, which is the half its already-shipping 'local-agent' tool does not have and the near-miss this entry was classified to prevent: LocalAgentPanel plans and queues objectives through window.api.localAgentPlan and has no provider target, no cloud fallback, no request budgets, no spend ledger and no per-conversation plan approval. The new tool has all of those, over the SAME main-owned conversation store: it loads the workspace through agentWorkspaceClient, picks a target from the shared AGENT_CLOUD_TARGETS, bounds a request with the shared input/output budget constants and clamps, and sends it through executeAgentPrompt — the same boundary the Study OS shell uses, verified by putting the built request through normalizeAgentExecutionRequest in test. AgentSpendPanel, AgentGovernancePanel and AgentConversationPlanQueue are IMPORTED UNCHANGED from components/agent/ rather than reimplemented; the target list, the refusal-key map and the two id minters were EXTRACTED to components/agent/agentExecutionTargets.ts in the same commit so both shells read one list, and a test fails if the Study OS shell ever re-inlines its own copy. Two rules the port must never break, both tested with a mutation control: allowLocalFallback is forced false on a local target (asserted by ticking it under a cloud target then switching back, the one arrangement where the naive shape disagrees), and allowSensitiveContext is always false because Blanc ships no consent control and must not claim consent it never collected — the boundary refuses with 'sensitive-context' instead. NOT covered, so 'covered' is not misread as parity: the capability directory, prompt library, pipeline terminal, context suggestions, attachments and vision, result cards, the context shelf, history search, pinning and archiving stay in the Study OS surface. This is the EXECUTION half, which is what a Blanc tool is for; nothing that worked before this port stops working.

files.note: Ported Blanc-native 2026-09-06 as the 'files' tool (BlancFilesPanel.tsx). Composes the SAME pure core and the SAME data hook as the Study OS surface — shared/filesApp/catalog.ts for the derived tree, counts, scope, search and sort, and components/filesapp/useFilesIndex for the one index fetch — so the two cannot come to disagree about the same library; Pillar 0 forbids mounting a *View or importing AppChrome, not sharing the domain logic. Carries the three behaviours the plan pins: an empty category is SHOWN reading 0 (gate 1's instrument, and a tree that drops empty nodes cannot be checked for it), Reveal is absent with a stated reason where the store has no folder (gate 12), and an enumerator that failed is NAMED so a category at 0 is never mistaken for an honest zero. Open routes through Blanc's own toolbox:open-tool — now dispatched cancelable, so the caller can tell whether Blanc claimed it — and falls back to openSectionSurface, which pops the section out as a real window; nothing that worked before this port stops working. Blanc's 'file-search' tool is STILL NOT coverage for this section and must never be recorded as such: it is a filename search over a folder the user picks with toolboxPickSearchFolder, i.e. a DISK browser, and FILES_APP_PLAN.md's Decision 2 is the opposite — the tree is what the app owns, over heterogeneous stores (SQLite rows, localStorage, main JSON, derived state), never real directories. The Files app ABSORBED the Notebook section: 'notebook' left DESKTOP_WIN_SECTIONS and became a LEGACY_WIN_SECTION_ALIASES entry pointing here, so a persisted desktop window with section 'notebook' now opens THIS surface — which is why its stale manifest entry was removed on 2026-09-06 rather than left claiming coverage. Blanc's 'notebook' TOOL still exists and is unaffected. NOT covered, so 'covered' is not misread as parity: collections, favourites, smart folders, the cleanup and scan sheets, deletion, mining and the memory/statistics panels stay in the Study OS surface — this is the FIND half, which is what a Blanc tool is for.

visualnovels.reason: New Study OS section 2026-09-24 (the Visual Novel platform, previously reachable only inside Immersion, which Blanc covers). Its live-capture and reader loop runs in main and in a dedicated reader window, so a Blanc tool would be a library/route view over the same visual-novel IPC; not built yet.
